# Abhijeet Gorhe — Video Editor in Nashik

> Abhijeet Gorhe (Abhijeet Sanjay Gorhe / Abhijeet Rajshree Sanjay Gorhe) is a video editor in Nashik district, based in Malegaon, Maharashtra, India. He edits documentaries, visual-storytelling Reels, Shorts and YouTube videos and provides motion design and cinematic colour grading for creators and brands in Nashik, Malegaon and worldwide. He is also a Computer Science Engineer.

## Services
- Documentary editing: narration-led edits with archival footage, animated maps, captions and pacing
- Visual storytelling: Reels, Shorts and YouTube edits built around one clear story
- Motion design: kinetic typography, animated maps, explainers and titles in After Effects
- Cinematic editing & colour grading: film-style cuts and consistent cinematic looks matched to a reference

## Selected work (on https://abhijeetgorhe.me/#work)
- Case File: Lalganj — crime-documentary intro (documentary)
- Same Story, New Edit — his cut of a Dhruv Rathee documentary segment shown beside the original (documentary)
- The Cola Price War — business story with 3D podiums and kinetic titles, beside the reference (motion design)
- If Nature & AI Worked Together — talking-head reel re-imagined as a visual story (visual storytelling)
- Science Experiment Short — 60-second kids science Short for Omkar (visual storytelling)
- Warm Cinematic Grade, Moody Room Grade, Fashion Shoot Grade — before/after colour grades

## Tools
Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, Illustrator, Lightroom, Adobe XD; AI tools: ChatGPT, Claude, Google AI.

- Location: Malegaon, Nashik district, Maharashtra, India. Works in person around Nashik and Malegaon and remotely worldwide.

  - Full Stack Web Developer Intern, 10xTech (Mumbai), Jul 2026 – present.
